tool_input.command:
FX=/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec120/fx; cd $FX && P=$FX/plugins/system-spec-harness;
python3 -B $FX/plugins/dev-graph/skills/run-dev-graph-system-spec/scripts/build-evaluation-context.py --context-receipt $FX/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json --output eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json; echo "helper=$?"
python3 -B $P/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts/aggregate-completeness.py --report $FX/eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json --spec-dir $FX/system-spec --session f4f10424-d995-4451-be78-9d34a26e9fe3; echo "agg=$?"
python3 -B $P/scripts/validate-coverage-matrix.py --matrix $FX/system-spec/spec-state.json --require-complete --require-basis --require-foundation; echo cov=$?
python3 -B $P/scripts/validate-source-citation.py --targets $FX/system-spec/spec-state.json --references $FX/system-spec/fetched-references.json --state $FX/system-spec/spec-state.json --repo-root $FX; echo cit=$?
python3 -B $FX/plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py --graph "$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$FX/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json'))['local_state_paths']['graph'])")" --repo-root $FX --strict-artifact-readiness; echo schema=$?
python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$FX/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json'));print(d['repo_root'],d['content_roots'])"
git -C $FX status --porcelain | head; git -C $FX diff --stat | tail -2
